snippet.title: 🦌 GOO DEER MULTIPLAYER IS FINALLY HERE!
snippet.description:
The night shift just got a whole lot more chaotic! Goo Deer's massive 2.0 Multiplayer Update lets you team up with friends and experience the madness together!

Run your own gas station, stock shelves, serve customers, hunt deer in the mysterious forest, and survive the terrifying dangers lurking in the fog.

Work together, split up responsibilities, and try to keep your business running while everything around you descends into chaos.

Can you and your friends survive the night?

🎮 GET GOO DEER ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4349210/Goo_Deer/

💬 JOIN OUR OFFICIAL DISCORD:
https://discord.gg/45yfd4ku3K

Goo Deer is a first-person horror management game developed by VML Studios, combining gas station simulation, survival horror, hunting, and multiplayer teamwork.

If you enjoy co-op horror games, chaotic multiplayer experiences, and unique indie games, check out Goo Deer!

👍 Like the video, subscribe for future updates, and tell us what you think of multiplayer in the comments!

Developed & Published by VML Studios : https://vmlstudios.net/

#GooDeer #Multiplayer #CoopHorror
